desc.testo: Whitbread plc is a British multinational hotel company headquartered in Houghton Regis, England. The business was founded as a brewery in 1742 by Samuel Whitbread in partnership with Godfrey and Thomas Shewell, with premises in London at the junction of Old Street and Upper Whitecross Street, along with a brewery in Brick Lane, Spitalfields.
desc.trad: Whitbread plc è una multinazionale alberghiera britannica con sede a Houghton Regis, Inghilterra. L'azienda è stata fondata come birrificio nel 1742 da Samuel Whitbread in collaborazione con Godfrey e Thomas Shewell, con sede a Londra all'incrocio tra Old Street e Upper Whitecross Street, insieme a un birrificio a Brick Lane, Spitalfields.
